title: Should i change my capsule art? I really would like to tone down the AI feel =>
author: AC-Daniel
selftext:
Hello,

  
i had a bit of a sad post here last week since people roasting me about creating AI slop. Well, i feel that the game itself is not slop and there is a lot of work in it. But - of course if the capsule screams like AI , i can say what i want and keep improving the product but still get "canceled" => 

  
So my question would be, would the new capsule improve the first impression => or is it super bad.? It features more in game "like" art and does not showcase the typical chatGPT texture noise.  Happy about any suggestion how to improve.

Here you find the current capsule:

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5282860/Necrolord/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5282860/Necrolord/)

comments.author: PositiveScarcity8909
comments.body:
The problem besides being obviously AI, is that it looks bad.

Nothing makes real sense when you think about it.

replies.author: AC-Daniel
replies.body: ok thank you, maybe i should at least get rid of the "noisy" texture i guess?

comments.author: Weekly-Unit6149
comments.body: Consider hiring an artist for this. The capsule is crucial—it’s your game’s calling card—so it’s worth the investment. Your current capsule is better, but it still has an AI-generated look.

comments.author: Upper-Philosophy2376
comments.body:
you won't be able to hide the AI-ness of it since the graphics in game also are an easy tell.

That said, the title card can make a big difference and you should consider doing it better. The easiest thing to do would be to use an example or two as inspiration/template this site shows some good ones [https://www.steamcapsule.com/](https://www.steamcapsule.com/), asking a graphic designer friend, or someone who makes youtube thumbnails might also be helpful.

replies.author: AC-Daniel
replies.body: Really wondering how the ingame art is an easy tell :D - i mean i dont mind and i got an AI disclaimer. Just dont want it to look like first generation spaghetti will smith

replies.author: Upper-Philosophy2376
replies.body: it doesn't look like stable diffusion 1.5, rather it looks like ChatGPT spritework, I can't explain how to recognize the look of it other than to say that most people who play with AI a lot (like me) or people under 25 will recognize it.

comments.author: Jolly-Rip5973
comments.body:
I don't think the cover art matters as much as the screenshots and gameplay trailer.   
I wouldn't worry about it too much. 

I also wouldn't worry too much about the game looking Ai. It's going to have disclosure anyways. 

The game needs to look like it's fun to play most of all and the trailer videos are going to show that. 

You might make a better trailer....put some concepts in there. 

Build!   
Recruit!   
Resurrect your army!   
Pillage the land!   
Become the ultimate Lich King! 

Try to make it seem exciting!

replies.author: Ashamed-Cost-5548
replies.body: hard disagree about capsule art. invest 200-300 USD for it

comments.author: OriginlessGamer
comments.body: I love it, it tells me exactly what the game is about. The actual capsule on your current steam page is also fine.

comments.author: Jolly-Rip5973
comments.body:
by the way. I found this website that features popular game capsule artwork for steam. 

[https://www.steamcapsule.com/guide](https://www.steamcapsule.com/guide) 

You might find this useful.

comments.author: thvaz
comments.body: The capsules look good. Nowadays something looks AI if it looks above the perceived budget of a project, which is a pity.

comments.author: Anubiz_Mr
comments.body:
Hey dude, I made this recently to help developers like myself. It's free to use. Let me know east you think!

https://www.capsulecheck.dev/

comments.author: DetectiveExisting803
comments.body: What model are you using to create the art ?
